knownIssues.symptom: On DXVK, switching away with Cmd+Tab in fullscreen crashes the game (M4 Pro, Wine 11 r31, highball-db#1284)
On DXVK the game closes by itself during play, without switching away, after about 18 minutes in one session and 1.5 in the next (M4 Pro, Wine 11 r31, highball-db#1320)
Laggy in the environment Highball sets up for Ubisoft Connect, which uses DXMT with sync off (M4 Pro, Wine 11 r31, highball-db#1284)
After a change of graphics mode the game keeps the old one while Ubisoft Connect is still running, and Highball says the environment was not restarted (M4 Pro, highball-db#1320)
On Wine's own Direct3D, Cmd+Space opens Spotlight over the game (M4 Pro, highball-db#1320)

notes: The upstream record does not specify a renderer. DXMT is the starting default.
